facts.text: I have been having issues with my sleep schedule and I am trying to get back on track.
I want to set reminders for my morning routine, including exercising and meditating.
I want to wake up at 7:30 am.
I want to start exercising at 7:45 am.
I want to start meditating at 8:15 am.
I want to commit to my routine 5 days a week, from Monday to Friday.
I prefer to receive notifications on my phone.
I want one reminder 30 minutes before waking up.
I want another reminder 15 minutes before waking up.
I want to track my daily activities, including what time I eat, exercise, and sleep, to see patterns and make adjustments.
I want to use Habitica to track my habits.
I want to set up a daily task for tracking my sleep schedule, including what time I go to bed and what time I wake up.
I want a goal to get at least 7-8 hours of sleep each night.
I want to track my morning exercise and meditation habits separately rather than combining them into one task.

events.text: Set morning routine reminders for waking up, exercising, and meditating on weekdays
events.date_hint: Monday to Friday (5 days a week)

events.text: Plan to track daily activities (eating, exercise, sleep) to identify patterns
